cohort: 249 pregnant women with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection at a University Hospital in Southern Italy between August 1, 2020 and January 1, 2021.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnant women during the first pandemic wave in Southern Italy was associated with relatively low rates of maternal and perinatal adverse outcomes.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 31.0 +/- 6.7 weeks
